'''Joe Horbey Endor Harvest''' is a [[Light]] constructed list [[Joe Horbey]] published on [[The Outer Rim (fan site)|The Outer Rim]].<ref name="or">[http://www.geocities.com/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/balancedecks/16lite.htm Endor Harvest], The Outer Rim (Joe Horbey). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20020217192936/http://www.geocities.com:80/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/balancedecks/16lite.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Joe Horbey]]
* '''Published:''' by 12 May 2001 (The Outer Rim)
* '''Published title:''' ''Endor Harvest''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Tatooine: Lars' Moisture Farm|Premiere-L-tatooinelarsmoisturefarm.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PEndor Endor Harvest Horbey LS 2001.txt |Download]] (omits Wise Advice (Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty), Do, Or Do Not (Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty): not in GEMP)
* '''Strategy:''' Endor Harvest

== Introduction ==

Joe Horbey posted this Harvest list on The Outer Rim DS II & Beyond index as Endor Harvest.
